feasibility_decision.label: MODEL INFERENCE
feasibility_decision.status: Provisional system retained for preproduction audit; published-catalyst reproduction gate blocked
feasibility_decision.central_question: Does a coordination-only adsorption explanation remain sufficient after substrate reduction and competitive donor/solvent binding are treated explicitly?
feasibility_decision.minimum_executable_batch: Molecular 1a neutral/reduced structures and a fixed-nuclear-geometry equilibrium-ALPB charging diagnostic in DMF, with solvent and electronic-structure sensitivity. This is not a physical vertical electron affinity: the equilibrium implicit-solvent response is allowed to change with charge. It is neither a catalyst effect, an electrode potential nor an electron-transfer activation barrier.
feasibility_decision.gate: No CuN3P1 vs CuN4 production comparison until structural provenance and baseline settings are obtained. Do not invent published Cartesian coordinates.
